about.title: About Dysart Unified School District
about.content: Dysart Unified School District serves families in the West Valley area of Maricopa County, including Surprise and nearby communities. Its calendar is especially important for household planning because students are dismissed early on Mondays, and because K–8 conferences, high school final exams, and graduation days use separate early-release rules.

about.title: District Calendar and School-Level Schedules
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide Dysart dates. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, preschool-specific calendars, bus routes, testing, athletics, performances, graduation ceremony details, and campus updates.

planningTips.title: Dysart Calendar Notes
content: Dysart schedules early dismissal on Mondays when school is in session, beginning near the start of the school year, for teacher professional development.
K–8 parent-teacher conferences are half days and do not apply to high schools the same way.
High school final exam dates are half days for high school students, while some semester-end dates also affect K–8 students.
The district publishes preschool calendar resources separately from the main K–12 school calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Does Dysart have early dismissal on Mondays?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Dysart schedules early dismissal on Mondays when school is in session for teacher professional development. Check the current school-year calendar for the first applicable Monday.

districtFaqs.q: Are Dysart K–8 conference dates half days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Dysart marks K–8 parent-teacher conference dates as half days for K–8 students.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Dysart calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Dysart school-year calendars page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Dysart Unified School District.
